RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the August 23, 2005/Bhadrapada 1, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance;
Panchayati Raj; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Report of IWMI on depletion of
ground water
*381. SHRI RAJU PARMAR: Will the
Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have studied
the report of International Water
Management Institute (IWMI) on depletion
of ground water;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c) what steps Government propose to
take to improve ground water level based
on the recommendations of the IWMI?
Outstanding amount of Government
against different States
†*382. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the amount outstanding from
the Central Government against different
States, State-wise;
(b) the details of the measures suggested
by the Twelfth Finance Commission to do
away with the revenue deficit of the States
as well as to check the increased fiscal deficit
and the reaction of the Government thereon;
and
(c) what are the steps being taken by
Government to encourage the States to do
away with the revenue deficit and to check
the increasing fiscal deficit?
Expenditure on India Shining
campaign
*383. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
did not obtain the approval of the Parliament
before incurring expenditure of Rs. 63.23
crores on media campaign styled as 'India
Shining';
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

120
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government incurred the expenditure
through diversion of funds although this
activity was not contemplated in the
annual budget; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Health tourism destination
*384. DR. KARAN SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India's private hospitals are
all set to give the historical sites in the country
tough competition, with the Government
ready to lure foreigners to get an altogether
different kind of tourism;
(b) if so, whether the Ministry has finally
decided to launch India as a health tourism
destination;
(c) if so, what are the main points of the
scheme;
(d) to what extent this scheme has been
made applicable to all the tourist spots in
the country; and
(e) to what extent it has been welcomed
by the tourists?
Disinvestment of SCI
*385. SHRI R. SHUNMUGA-
SUNDARAM: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry approved
disinvestment of the Shipping Corporation
of India;
(b) if so, how much of the total stakes
would be disinvested; and
(c) the purpose of disinvestment in SCI?
Promotion of tourism
*386. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased
to state:
(a) whether new initiatives and marketing
strategies have been formulated by
Government for promotion of tourism during
2005-06;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps being taken by Government
for increasing the number of tourists and
ensuring them safety in our country?
Development of surrounding areas
*387. SHRI SILVIUS CONDPAN: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state, the
percentage of profit made by Oil India
Limited/ONGC invested for the all-round
development of the area surrounding their
project area in Assam?
Air services in North East
*388. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the people of Tripura, particularly the
students from Tripura pursuing studies in
other States of the North-East are facing
great troubles for not having air-flights
between Agartala and Silchar and Agartala
and Imphal;
(b) whether 50-seater air crafts will be
deployed at least twice a week in the above
sectors with an immediate effect;
(c) if so, by when; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

121
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Theft cases at IGI Airport, Delhi
†*389. SHRI PYARELAL  KHAN-
DELWAL: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of incidents of theft
registered at Indira Gandhi International
Airport during the last one year; and
(b) the steps being taken to stop the
incidents of theft at the airport?
Tapping of underground water by soft
drinks MNCs
*390. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Minister of
WATER RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many soft
drinks MNCs have been tapping
underground water;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to stop the draining of country's water
resources?
Senior Citizens Saving Scheme, 2004
*391. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the percentage of interest being
allowed on interest earned under Senior
Citizens Saving Scheme, 2004;
(b) if reply to above be in the negative
the reasons for denial of legitimate earnings
of such depositors;
(c) whether Government have
discontinued periodical entries of interest
in Pass Books issued to depositors, under
Senior Citizens Saving Scheme, 2004; and
(d) if so, the utility of such Pass Books
issued to depositors?
Outstanding loan of AI and IA
*392. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Air India and Indian Airlines
have in their books large outstanding loans
from January 1989 to March 2005;
(b) whether the AI and IA stand
committed to pay up the guarantee fee
covering Central Government's guarantees
of external borrowings; and
(c) if so, the quantum of accumulated
outstanding of guarantee fee payable by AI
and IA as on 31.3.2004?
Construction of International Airport
at Chakan
†*393. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether MIDC is constructing an
International Airport at Chakan near Pune;
(b) whether Government also propose
to construct an international cargo hub in
it;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Enhancement of eligibility limit for
payment of bonus
*394. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to enhance
the eligibility limit for payment of bonus
from three thousand five hundred rupees
to a suitable limit;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

122
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Financial package to Himachal
Pradesh
†*395. SHRI SURESH BHARDWAJ:
SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
 Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Prime Minister has
announced to give financial package to the
State Government of Himachal Pradesh, if
so, amount of fund given;
(b) items and schemes for which fund
has been released under the said financial
package;
(c) whether any special assistance has
been given for the annual plan of the State
in this financial package, if so, details
thereof; and
(d) whether the State has been given
funds in addition to those given for annual
plan in this financial package and if so, the
details thereof?
Complaints of poor crisis management
at Delhi airport
*396. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
passengers whose flights to Mumbai were
diverted to Delhi have complained about
poor crisis management at the Delhi airport
and many of them could not be provided
accommodation;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
meet the crisis in such a situation at the
Delhi airport?
Subsidies on kerosene and LPG
*397. SHRI RAASHID ALVI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether his Ministry has asked the
Ministry of Finance to provide subsidies
on PDS kerosene and domestic LPG in a
transparent manner;
(b) whether he had asked the Minister
of Finance to make higher annual provisions
in the budget towards subsidising kerosene
and LPG;
(c) if so, what are the other steps that
the Ministry is considering to make oil
subsidies transparent; and
(d) to what extent he has been able to
achieve the aims?
World Heritage Sites
*398. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of TOURISM
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the revenue earned by
each prominent and World Heritage Sites
and the amount spent for their maintenance
and renovation every year;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
attract more tourists, both domestic and
foreign, to the tourist sites in the current year;
and
(c) whether such steps have yielded the
desired results?

123

The 17th August, 2005 Secretary-General.

Empowering ombudsmen to look
into complaints of credit card
holders
*399. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of ombudsmen working
under RBI;
(b) whether it is a fact that RBI propose
to empower ombudsmen to look into
complaints of aggrieved credit card holders
against banks indulging in unfair practices
like imposing service charges even when the
card is not used, etc.; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Incredible India Campaign
*400. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the status of the "Incredible
India" campaign in attracting tourists;
(b) what is the enhancement in earnings
after the launch of the above campaign;
(c) whether in order to promote
tourism, Government are identifying new
destinations and circuits; and
(d) if so, the details of the circuits located
in Orissa and in other States?

Development of civil aviation in Uttar
Pradesh
†2814. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the projects sanctioned
for development of civil aviation in Uttar
Pradesh during the Tenth Five Year Plan;
(b) the projects on which work has been
initiated and whether the work is proceeding
as per schedule; and;
(c) if not, the steps taken and those
proposed to be taken for timely completion
of these projects?
Conversion of airstrip at Karwar into
a full fledged international airport
2815. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have received
proposal from the State Government of
Karnataka to convert the proposed airstrip
at the Karwar Naval base into a full-fledged
international airport;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Sea-Bird
plan includes building of an airstrip;
(c) whether the required land for the
purpose has been acquired; and;
(d) by when, the final approval will be
accorded in this regard?
Ahmedabad-New York air service
†2816. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
 SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Air India plans to start a
direct flight from Ahmedabad to New York
on all the seven days of the week;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Operation of international services
from Ahmedabad
†2817. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
operate international flights by private
airlines from Ahmedabad; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Merger of IAAI and NAA
2818. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for not implementing
the recommendations of the J.D. Jain
Committee even after ten years;
(b) the reasons for promoting
employees of erstwhile National Airports
Authority (NAA) and International
Airports Authority of India (IAAI) on
different norms after merger in violation of
the provisions of para 18 of the AAI Act of
1994 passed by the Parliament; and
(c) what steps his Ministry has taken/
proposed to take to ensure that the AAI
Act of 1994 is implemented in true spirit?
Unauthorised absence of pilots
†2819. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether going on leave by pilots
without any intimation is in accordance
with rules;
(b) if not, what action Government
initiate against such pilots;
(c) whether it is a fact that the daily
flight  from Kochi to Lakshadweep
remained suspended for many days due to
absence of pilots from duty  without any
intimation;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what concrete steps Government are
taking to avert such unfortunate incident in
future?
Helipad near Sun Temple, Konark
2820.  SHRI R.K. ANAND:
 SHRIMATI PREMA
 CARIAPPA:
 Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Orissa has built a helipad
within 2 Km. radius of the Sun Temple at
Konark;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Archaeological Survey of India asked the
State Government not to use the helipad as
it poses a threat to the security of the 13th
Century World Heritage site; and;
(c) if so, the detials thereof and what action
taken/proposed to be taken against such
construction within a World Heritage site?
Passengers stranded at Chennai
Airport
2821. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that international
passengers of Air India were stranded at
Chennai Airport recently and the Air India
had totally failed to retrieve them for more
than 14 hours in the airport itself whereas
airlines like Malaysia Airlines, Singapore
Airlines could give excellent facilities in a
similar situation;
(b) whether it is due to system failure
or human failure or both; and
(c) what are the special measures
envisaged to meet such situations in future?

641
Performance of aviation sector
2822. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken by Government in
the last five years to keep pace with the
private airlines in terms of performance,
profits, etc.;
(b) whether the steps undertaken by
Government have borne fruit;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not the reasons therefor?
Restructuring of DGCA
2823. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
for restructuring Directorate General of
Civil Aviation (DGCA) under his Ministry
on the lines of TRAI of Telecommunication
Department;
(b) if not, when it is expected to be
restructured; and
(c) the details thereof?
Authority to regulate private airlines
2824. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether some private scheduled
airlines harass passengers by sudden
cancellation of flights or delay in starting
of flights without any valid reason;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the action taken against such airlines;
(d) whether it is proposed to constitute
an authority to regulate all airlines;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Revival of Cooch Behar airport
2825. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the aerodrome in Cooch Behar (West
Bengal) lies deserted even though it could
have served a large number of people of the
region;
(b) if so, what steps are being taken to
revive it; and
(c) whether there is any proposal or
plan to resume air service from the
aerodrome and if so, the details thereof?
Free tickets on compassionate
grounds
2826. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the facilities being
provided by Indian Airlines (IA) and Air
India (AI) to senior citizens, women and
serious patients including handicapped
persons;
(b) the number of free tickets given by
Air India/Indian Airlines on compassionate
grounds to patients suffering from serious
ailments during the last three years and till
date;
(c) the criteria adopted for providing
such facilities;
(d) whether the above mentioned
category of persons have made any demand
either to the Airlines or Government; and
(e) if so, the action taken by Government
in this regard?

642
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Air fares competition
†2827. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many
domestic airlines place advertisement in the
newspapers regarding fares;
(b) whether it is also a fact that many a
time these advertisements are misguiding;
(c) whether it is a fact that many
domestic airlines companies have entered
Indian skies and a kind of price war has
begin;
(d) whether it is also a fact that this
situation can lead to bankruptcy of many
companies that amounts to loss to Indian
aviation industry;
(e) if so, whether Government propose
to fix minimum fare on each domestic
sector;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Subsidy on airservices of North-
Eastern States
2828. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government's
efforts in making availability of airservices
in the North-East and other inaccessible
areas are lagging behind the expectations;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government provide
subsidies for air operations in those areas;
and
(d) if so, the details of Government's
support to the carriers with regard to
making air services more effective in the
inaccessible areas?
Extension of Bilaspur Airport
2829. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are plannning
to upgrade Raipur airport into international
airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government would
consider extending runways with additional
parking bays at Raipur and Bilaspur
airports with sufficient infrastructure and
if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether Government would provide
additional flights from Raipur and Bilaspur
to Delhi and connect other major cities and
if not, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the details of steps taken by
Government to connect Raipur, Durg,
Bhilai and Korba with other major cities of
Madhya Pradesh and Delhi?
Catering expenses of IA
2830. SHRI VAYALAR RAVI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the catering
expenses of the Indian Airlines are
abnormally high; and
(b) if so, what steps are being taken to
reduce the expenditure on catering
especially in the case of short route sectors?
Speedy clearance of passengers at
airports
2831. SHRI VAYALAR RAVI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
all the major airports in India are very much
congested and passengers find it difficult

643
to pass through the security checks as the
facilities are very limited; and
(b) if so, what steps are being taken to
reduce the pressure and speedy clearance
of the passengers in the airports?
Price negotiations with Boeing
Corporation
2832. SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS
KAUR: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether price negotiations for the
purchase of Boeing aircrafts has since been
completed with the Boeing Corporation;
(b) if so, the conclusions about actual
price of the aircraft indicating the final cost
to be incurred on the purchase; and
(c) the other relevant terms of the
purchase?
Funds for modernisation of airports
2833. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Airports
Authority of India proposes to raise
Rs. 3,000 to 4,000 crores to develop the
facilities at 25 non-metro airports across
the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what are the sources of funding of
these projects?
Air-services agreement with Germany
2834. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that after US,
UK and France, India has finalized Bilateral
Air-services Agreement with Germany;
(b) if so, the details of the Agreement;
(c) the number of flights that fly at
present from each country; and
(d) the details of points of call given to
Germany and what are the additional points
that India would cover in Germany through
the new agreement?
International airports
2835. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of international airports
in the country, State-wise;
(b) whether there is a long and
persistent demand for upgradation of the
Bajpe (Mangalore) Airport in Karnataka
into an international airport considering
the significant passenger traffic and export
and import trade from the Bajpe Airport;
and
(c) if so, the details in this regard and
Centre's reaction thereto?
Facilities to stranded passengers at
Mumbai airport
2836. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the losses suffered by Air India and
Indian Airlines, due to cancellation and
diversion of flights following the closure
of Mumbai airport due to heavy rains;
and
(b) what facilities were provided by
Airlines and Airports Authority of India to
the stranded passengers in Mumbai and
other major airports?

644
Restoration of Mumbai airport
terminals
2837. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the damage caused to the
international and domestic terminal of
Mumbai airport following the recent heavy
rains; and
(b) what steps have been taken by the
Airports Authority of India to repair and
restore Mumbai airport terminals?
IA's proposal to join Global Airlines
Alliance
2838. SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
Airlines is planning to join a Global Airlines
Alliance;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Upgradation of Lucknow airport
2839. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal to
upgrade the Lucknow (Amausi) and
Amritsar (Rajasansi) airports into
ultramodern airports;
(b) if so, whether the work thereon
has been held up; if so, the details of the
projects and at what stage it has been held
up; and
(c) the progress made thereon, so far?
Effect of poaching of pilots
2840. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the informal 'No Poaching'
agreement reached between public sector
and private sector airlines is working as
expected;
(b) whether both Indian Airlines and
Alliance Airways are feeling the crunch of
pilot shortage and whether of late, most of
the departure schedules have gone away;
(c) what contingency measures are
planned by the Directorate General of Civil
Aviation to prevent such abrupt exit of the
crew; and
(d) whether the DGCA proposes to
revoke licenses of the crew in the event of
their quitting employment without
adequate notice?
New baggage clearance system
2841. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to put the modern "In Line"
system in all major airports in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
automated machine baggage clearance
system, if installed, will help to ease the
congestion at the airports; and
(d) if so, the steps taken in this regard?
MCA-21 for online information of
Registrar of Companies
2842. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have launched

645
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Rs. 341 crore project christened as "MCA-
21", to connect the Ministry with all  its
regional offices and the 22 Registrars of
Companies across the country with a
centralised system to provide on-line
information to all the stakeholders including
public, financial institutions and companies;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Reimbursement of taxi fare
2843. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Central
Government employees residing in
peripherals towns of NCR i.e. NOIDA,
Bahadurgarh, Faridabad, Gurgaon, etc. are
not allowed reimbursement of taxi/scooter
fare when they attend office on holidays or
processed on tour;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and
whether Government propose to issue
suitable revised order so as to make the
official residing in peripherals towns eligible
for reimbursement of taxi/scooter charges
and also allow Government vehicles to enter
the areas under reference as a routine matter
since number of Government offices have
been shifted thereof; and
(c) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Customs gate in Indo-Myanmar border
2844. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that apart from
Moreh (Manipur) there is another customs
gate namely Zowkhatari Hai in the Indo-
Myanmar border;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the said
gate is not operational for border trade;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether Government proposed to
make the said gate operational and if not,
the reason therefor?
Sale of 20 per cent shares of BHEL
